description: Capability for the main window. NOTE core:window:allow-close: it lets the webview close its own window, which now routes through the close prompt instead of quitting. Its only in-tree caller is the e2e suite, which has to exercise the REAL CloseRequested path because WebDriver cannot click the native traffic light. Deliberate, not accidental: the user can already close the window, and Rust intercepts the request either way.
